Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping

package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.dcat.mapping
The mapping between DCAT documents and open metadata. DcatMapper catalogs the catalogs, datasets, dataset series and data services from a DCAT document as open metadata elements. DcatGenerator creates the DCAT description of an asset, or of a collection of assets. Both work through a connector context so that they can be called from an integration connector or from a view service.
